note: Lavender articles room with grey-wood boards (cartoon style). Landmark: the little puppet theatre with a red curtain under the sign. Back row left to right: le (man lugging a sack), la (opera singer), les (girl in garlands), un (one finger), une (one huge spoon); front row: des (daisies), du (dew in a cup), au (oar), aux (the wizard pointing at the doors). Zooms: the coat-peg corner (possessives mon, ton, son, notre, votre, leur) and the teacher's desk (le nom, l'article). The open door at the back left goes out to the school yard; the peach door on the right leads to the questions room. Determiners mark gender but have none themselves (divider null).
